scope: Prime Keeper coverage for the current playable game. Historical variants, costumes and speculative activities are listed separately from the launch-facing interaction set.

priorities.title: Finish consuming already-installed motion
priorities.why: No new drawing is required. These approved sprites need state-machine routes, object anchors and endpoint tests before the game can use them.
required: turn controller using the installed front/side/back transitions
sit → activity → stand controller for all four seat directions
ladder routing when a ladder layout is active
darts activity route and board/dart ownership

priorities.title: Missing circulation connectors
priorities.why: These are visible seams in ordinary movement and should be settled before expanding the activity catalogue.
required: front-door approach, open/hidden handoff, enter and leave

priorities.title: Food and kitchen
priorities.why: Eating is a core need and the generic rear-work loop is only a temporary body fallback, not complete prop choreography.
required: open fridge, take snack and eat
cook at cooker with owned utensils/food
carry/serve/eat endpoints that return to a known standing or seated pose

priorities.title: Rest and indoor leisure
priorities.why: The sit/stand foundation is installed, but each activity still needs its own approved performance and furniture registration.
required: get into bed, sleep/nap loop and get out

priorities.title: Bathroom and hygiene
priorities.why: These are ungated daily needs and need complete, discreet object-specific routes rather than one generic rear-work loop.
required: loo seated/hidden performance for both current commands

priorities.title: Household work and lamp room
priorities.why: These actions use different hand positions, tools and viewpoints; the held-implement proxy cannot be reused as approved body art.
required: sweep, basic hoover and upgraded hoover with production-approved held-tool bodies

priorities.title: Phone, visitors and shared activities
priorities.why: These make the lighthouse feel inhabited and need two-character spacing or handheld-object continuity.
required: phone call, answer and pizza order

priorities.title: Outside and pet life
priorities.why: Important variety after the indoor daily-life loop is coherent; each needs environment or second-character coordination.

priorities.title: Mission-unlocked rooms
priorities.why: These can follow the core house because players do not see them until their rooms unlock.

priorities.title: Expressive reaction set
priorities.why: Forty-four typed reactions currently collapse onto eleven generic legacy motion families.

priorities.title: Costumes, upgrades and optional catalogue
priorities.why: Do this only after the standard-uniform Prime routes are complete; otherwise every missing transition multiplies across outfits.
required: sou'wester, party, swimming and scuba locomotion
mood idles and long-tail historical production-bank variants
